reconciliation.item: Total portfolio valuation including held-for-sale and ROU

columns_never_fillable.reason: MLT discloses NPI only by GEOGRAPHIC SEGMENT, never per property. Checked: Note 29 Segment Information (pages 223-225) breaks NPI into the nine markets (Singapore 173,592; Hong Kong SAR 114,632; China 108,924; Japan 75,978; South Korea 50,170; Australia 46,702; Malaysia 31,771; Vietnam 27,035; India 6,140; Total 634,944 S$'000, page 224). The audited Group Portfolio Statement (pages 122-165) and Property Portfolio review (pages 62-80) give per-property Gross revenue but NO per-property NPI/property-expenses column. There is no per-property property-income note. Unlike K71U/T82U (which have per-property segment tables), NPI is genuinely absent per property for M44U.
NPI contribution is disclosed only as a geographic % (Note 29 page 224 shares, and the by-market NPI table page 35). No per-property NPI percentage is disclosed.
No per-property tenant list disclosed; tenant/customer concentrations are portfolio-level only (Top 10 customers by gross revenue, page 49/pages 2940-2957).

Per-property tables disclose NLA (sqm) in the audited Portfolio Statement metric columns are Gross revenue/occupancy/valuation (no area); NLA comes from the Property Portfolio review (pages 62-80). Country map callouts disclose only aggregate Total GFA (e.g. Singapore 1,802,835 sqm, page 62). Per-property GLA/GFA is not disclosed.

Same as gla: only aggregate Total GFA per country (map callouts, pages 62-80) is disclosed, never per property. The only per-property GFA figure in the report is the redevelopment note for 51 Benoi Road (36,300 -> ~82,400 sqm, page 33/34), which is a redevelopment target, not an as-built per-property GFA column.

The audited Portfolio Statement (pages 122-165) discloses Date of legal completion, Term of lease and Remaining term of lease (in years), not an explicit per-property lease-expiry calendar date; not computed.

All 61 rows with null effective_date/lease_term_years are FREEHOLD land (24 Japan, 21 South Korea, 13 Australia, 3 Malaysia). Freehold has no lease-start date and no finite lease term (Portfolio Statement shows Term of lease = 'Freehold', Remaining term = '-', e.g. Australia page 126, Japan page 156, Korea page 154, Malaysia page 150). Structurally N/A, not missing.

All 49 rows with null original_value/original_currency are Singapore properties whose transacting/local currency IS the SGD presentation currency, so there is no separate local-currency figure to record (original_value populated only for the 8 overseas markets AUD/JPY/RMB/HKD/KRW/MYR/VND/INR). N/A, not missing.
Report discloses an aggregate divestment loss of S$39k for seven transferred properties (Note 14(b)/Note 15, page 195), not per-property realized gains/losses.
Page 48 discloses gross sale prices and valuations; net proceeds after transaction costs are not disclosed per transaction.

null_recovery_sweep.performed: 2026-07-07 FY2024 null-recovery pass: swept every null field across all 187 property rows and 21 transaction rows against the confirmed anchor pages.
null_recovery_sweep.result: No disclosed-but-null values found. Every remaining null is a genuine disclosure gap ('-'/'—'/blank in the authoritative audited Group Portfolio Statement, pages 122-165) or structurally N/A. No values changed; no market_valuation regression (active+held-for-sale sum = S$13,088,234k, matches the reconciliation total).

null_recovery_sweep.net_property_income: Confirmed absent per property; see columns_never_fillable. NPI disclosed only geographically in Note 29 (pages 223-225).
null_recovery_sweep.transactions_nulls: All genuine: announced acquisitions in Binh Duong & Hung Yen (Vietnam) and pending divestment of Flexhub have no fixed transaction_date (page 47/48 give 'By 2Q FY24/25', not a date); Subang 1 divestment sale price/valuation bundled with Chee Wah (individual not disclosed, page 48); per-property carrying values for the 7 divested-at-carrying-value assets disclosed only in aggregate (S$210,150k, Note 15 page 195).

inferred.note: No NPI was computed/imputed for any M44U property. MLT does not disclose per-property property expenses, so the Revenue-minus-expenses derivation used for T82U is not applicable; NPI left null (geographic-only disclosure).
